description: Central sector income support scheme providing assured financial assistance of ₹6,000 per annum to all landholding farmer families across India having cultivable agricultural land in their names.
government_department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
annual_benefit: ₹6,000 / year (disbursed in 3 equal four-monthly installments of ₹2,000 directly via Aadhaar-linked DBT)
target_beneficiaries: Small and marginal landholder farmer families with cultivable land recorded in state land revenue portals

description: State welfare initiative of the Government of Karnataka granting monthly financial assistance of ₹2,000 to the recognized female head of the family (Yajamani) to support domestic economic autonomy and household stability.
government_department: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Karnataka
annual_benefit: ₹24,000 / year (paid monthly at ₹2,000 per month via Aadhaar-seeded bank account)
target_beneficiaries: Female head of the household (Yajamani) listed on Antyodaya, BPL, or APL ration cards in Karnataka
